# ==============================================================================
# oe_syn.1: Prester John Across the Red Sea — Aksum, Constantinople & Lisbon Envoys
# ==============================================================================
oe_syn.1 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_syn_prester_john_redsea.dds"
	title = oe_syn.1.t
	desc = oe_syn.1.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_syn_ev1_seen value = 1 }
			oe_syn_record_synthesis_done = yes
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_syn.1.a
		add_prestige = 12
		add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_syn_prester_john_redsea_mod
			years = 30
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = { oe_syn_chalcedon_reconciled = yes }
			custom_tooltip = oe_syn.1.chalcedon_gold_tt
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_syn_chalcedon_aksum_accord_mod
				years = 35
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 70 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_syn.1.b
		add_gold = 120
		add_stability = 4
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_syn_redsea_caravan_charter_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}
}
